info.name: HR Resume Ingestion - Phase-wise Verification
info.description:
Verifies every phase of Resume_Ingestion_Architecture_Phasewise.md (Phases 1-16) and the batch workflow in Batch_Ingestion_Flow.md.

Before running:
1. Start the server: npm run dev (http://localhost:3000).
2. Set the collection variable resumePath to a real resume PDF on your machine.
3. Requests that upload test-files/... resolve relative to Postman's working directory; if a file shows as missing, re-select postman/test-files/blank.pdf or not-a-pdf.txt in the request body.

item.name: Phase 1 - Project Setup
item.description: Server runs inside the single backend (npm run dev, port 3000).

item.name: Phase 2 - PDF Upload API
item.description: POST /v1/resume/upload with form-data field 'file'. PDF only, max 5MB.

item.name: Phase 3 - PDF Text Extraction
item.description: POST /v1/resume/extract. Text layer first; scanned PDFs are OCR'd. Blank PDFs fail with 'Resume extraction failed'.

item.name: Phase 4 - Text Cleaning
item.description: POST /v1/resume/clean with a PDF or JSON { rawText }.

exec: pm.test('no two identical lines in a row', () => {

body.raw:
{
  "rawText": "ASHWIN   P


• QA  Engineer ★
QA Engineer

	Email: ashwin@gmail.com ✉
“C#”, C++ – Node.js"
}

item.name: Clean with empty body is rejected
Phase 5 - Algorithm Resume Parser
item.description: POST /v1/resume/parse. Uses the algorithm parser, or the LLM parser when USE_LLM_PARSER=true.

body.raw:
{
  "rawText": "ASHWIN P
QA Engineer
Email: ashwin@gmail.com | Phone: +91 98765 43210 | Chennai
SUMMARY
QA Engineer with 3 years 4 months of experience in Java, Selenium and API Testing.
EXPERIENCE
QA Engineer | TCS | Jan 2023 - Present
EDUCATION
B.E Computer Science, Anna University, 2019
SKILLS
Java, Selenium, Playwright, Postman, SQL, MySQL, JavaScript, Jenkins"
}

exec: pm.test('parser follows USE_LLM_PARSER (algorithm or llm)', () => pm.expect(['algorithm', 'llm']).to.include(pm.response.json().data.parser));

item.name: Parse with empty body is rejected

item.name: Phase 7 - Skills Detection
item.description: POST /v1/resume/skills. Whole-word matching (Java is not JavaScript).

item.name: Word boundaries (Java vs JavaScript, SQL vs MySQL)

exec: pm.test('SQL not matched inside MySQL', () => pm.expect(skills).to.not.include('SQL'));
pm.test('aliases map to canonical names', () => pm.expect(skills).to.include.members(['Selenium', 'Rest Assured']));

item.name: Embed with empty body is rejected
Phase 10 - MongoDB Ingestion
item.description: Stored document in the resumes collection (hr_app database). The doc's POST /v1/resume/store endpoint is not implemented; storing happens inside POST /v1/resume/inject (Phase 11). These requests read a stored document back. The embedding is stored but never returned by the API.

exec: pm.test('at least one stored resume', () => pm.expect(d.total).to.be.above(0));

item.name: Stored document has the final fields
Phase 11 - Resume Ingestion Service
item.description: POST /v1/resume/inject: PDF -> extract -> clean -> parse -> embed -> MongoDB. The same file again returns 'Resume already ingested'.

item.name: Same file again is a duplicate
Phase 12 - Error Handling
item.description: Spec messages: Only PDF allowed, Resume extraction failed, Mistral embedding failed, ingestion failed. The last two need a broken Mistral key or MongoDB, so only the first two are checked here.

item.name: Inject blank PDF: Resume extraction failed

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("No file uploaded. Send a PDF in form-data field 'file'"));

item.name: Phase 13 - Logging
item.description: Each ingested resume logs one JSON line: requestId, fileName, extractMs, parseMs, embeddingMs, mongoInsertMs (check the npm run dev console). Every response also carries an X-Request-Id header.

item.name: Inject returns step timings and a request id
Phase 14 - Vector Search Index
item.description: The Atlas index (resume_vector) is created with npm run search:index, not an API. When it is queryable, semantic search runs in 'atlas' mode instead of 'local'.

item.name: Search uses the Atlas vector index
Phase 15 - Semantic Resume Search
item.description: POST /v1/resume/search with optional skills, experience and location filters.

exec: pm.test('mode is atlas or local', () => pm.expect(['atlas', 'local']).to.include(d.mode));
pm.test('sorted by score', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.score).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].score)));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("limit must be an integer between 1 and 50"));

item.name: Search with min > max experience is rejected

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("filters.minExperience must not be greater than filters.maxExperience"));

item.name: Phase 16 - Resume Management APIs
item.description: GET /v1/resumes, GET /v1/resumes/:id, DELETE /v1/resumes/:id. Only an unknown id is deleted here, so no real data is removed.

item.name: List resumes by skill and location

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("limit must be an integer between 1 and 100"));

item.name: Batch Ingestion (Batch_Ingestion_Flow.md)
item.description: Ingests .pdf, .docx and .doc files from RESUME_SOURCE_DIR in batches of 5 or 10. WARNING: the 'Run batch' requests ingest real files and call Mistral and Groq.

exec: pm.test('every supported file accounted for', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed + d.pending).to.eql(d.supportedFiles));
pm.test('every failure has a reason', () => d.failures.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.reason).to.be.a('string')));
pm.test('counts add up', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed).to.eql(d.selected));
pm.test('counts add up', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed).to.eql(d.selected));
pm.test('counts add up', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed).to.eql(d.selected));
